title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 27 September 2026
description: Today: OpenAI expands ChatGPT ads to more Asian markets as smaller labs chase efficiency gains; Brisbane completes an epic comeback to claim a historic AFL three-peat as the Army retires its Tiger helicopters; Queensland fights beach erosion at Moore Park while Darius Boyd is named Origin coach; and the Gold Coast's Jed Walter goes back-to-back at the Grand Final Sprint. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
